description_en: Queries the Tomcat configuration of an application or an instance group in which an application is deployed
description_zh: 调用GetContainerConfiguration接口获取应用或应用分组的Tomcat配置
name: GetContainerConfiguration

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the instance group.

If this parameter is specified, this operation queries the Tomcat configuration of the instance group.

If this parameter is not specified, this operation queries the Tomcat configuration of the application
parameters.help_zh:
分组ID。
如果ID不为空，则获取应用分组的Tomcat配置。
如果ID为“”，则获取应用的Tomcat配置
parameters.name: group_id

Code.description_en: The HTTP status code that is returned
Code.description_zh: 接口请求返回的状态码

ContextPath.description_en: The context path of the Tomcat container

HttpPort.description_en: The application port number for the Tomcat container. The value specified in the application configuration is returned
HttpPort.description_zh: 应用端口。返回设置的值和应用配置

MaxThreads.description_en:
The maximum number of threads in the Tomcat container.

If no instance group is specified, the configuration of the application is returned.

If no application is specified, the default configuration is returned
MaxThreads.description_zh:
最大线程数，返回设置的值。
如果应用分组未设置，则返回应用的配置。
如果应用未设置，则返回默认值

URIEncoding.description_en:
The Uniform Resource Identifier (URI) encoding scheme. Valid values: ISO-8859-1, GBK, GB2312, and UTF-8.

If no instance group is specified, the configuration of the application is returned.

If no application is specified, the default configuration is returned
URIEncoding.description_zh:
URI编码方式，包含ISO-8859-1、GBK、GB2312和UTF-8，返回设置的值。
如果应用分组未设置，则返回应用的配置。
如果应用未设置，则返回默认值

UseBodyEncoding.description_en:
Indicates whether useBodyEncodingForURI is enabled in the Tomcat container.

If no instance group is specified, the configuration of the application is returned.

If no application is specified, the default configuration is returned
UseBodyEncoding.description_zh:
useBodyEncodingForURI是否启用，返回设置的值。
如果应用分组未设置，则返回应用的配置。
如果应用未设置，则返回默认值

Message.description_en: The message returned for the request
